description: Run when a wallet was drained or money went missing, or before trusting an address someone gave you: follows the money and flags sweeper, pass-through and lookalike-address patterns. Follows a wallet's money through its recent transactions: net SOL and token change and the other side of each, where most money went, and drain patterns with evidence. Example: {"wallet": "<address>", "how_many": 25}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/trace.

before.description: Start below this transaction, to page further back. next_before from the previous answer.

how_many.description: How many recent transactions to read, newest first (1-50, default 25). More covers a longer stretch of time.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

wallet.description: The wallet to follow. The user's wallet, or an address from their report. Never make one up.

name: trace
